commands.example_content:
[Key Examples]
- Single key: enter, tab, space, backspace, delete
- Combination: ctrl+c, shift+alt+a, ctrl+shift+esc
- Sequence (select all then delete): ctrl+a, delete
- Sequence (copy then paste): ctrl+c, ctrl+v

[Text Examples]
Wrap text in single or double quotes:
- Type and press enter: "hello", enter
- Type current time: "now: {time}"
- Type today's date: "date: {date}"

To type quote characters, wrap with the other quote type:
- Type two double quotes and move cursor left: '""', left
- Type two single quotes and move cursor left: "''", left

Inside double quotes, escape " with \":
- "a\"b" -> types a"b
- Or just use single quotes: 'a"b'

[Run Program Examples]
- Simple program: calc
- With argument: python D:\script.py {content}
- With placeholder: echo "User said: {all_text}" >> log.txt

[Custom Working Directory]
Add {cwd:"absolute_path"} at the beginning:
  {cwd:"D:\my_work"} python run.py
  {cwd:"~/Desktop"} ./script.sh

[Placeholders]
{time} -> current HH:MM:SS (e.g. 14:30:25)
{date} -> today's date (e.g. 2026-08-08)
{content} -> remaining text after prefix match
{prefix} -> the matched pattern itself
{all_text} -> full text sent from phone
